requirements.title: Map-objective timer alerts
requirements.statement: The host shall raise non-critical map-objective alerts derived only from the GSI game clock (map.clock_time) while map.game_state is in progress and the game is not paused, using one patch-versioned timing table that names a source for every row. Each objective (water, power, bounty and wisdom rune, Tormentor first spawn) has a Settings switch, on by default, and zero to two pre-warning lead times of 5 to 60 s each; the defaults are 30 s and 15 s for water and power runes and none for the others; a spawn alert always follows while the objective is on. Roshan respawn and Tormentor respawn are reported unavailable. Each alert shows as a compact rounded card with an original objective glyph and a colour accent from the HUD's fixed dark palette (the HUD never follows the app theme), centred directly under the danger meter (RISK) with a 4 px gap by default, where it may enter the top of the protected announcement region by at most 24 px at 1080 (scaled with screen height) under the UI-015 allowance; the objective name stays in English and the sentence follows the saved app language, which the host sends with every alert (Thai examples: “Power rune จะเกิดใน 30 วินาที”, “Water rune เกิดแล้ว”; the English UI stays fully English). An event video banner may cover the card. The tone plays on the single-slot sink as soon as it is idle, within 5 s of the due time; a clip that is playing is never cut, ducked or delayed for it, and a tone not started within 5 s is dropped and logged as suppressed. Each objective plays its own original locally synthesized short soft tone (distinct pitch or pattern) at the announcer channel volume. The card's size and position follow the UI-015 layout. An opt-in local diagnostic may log only the GSI map key names and roshan_* values; the info log lines objective_alert_shown (kind, lead_s, clock, and whether the tone played, the card was covered or the tone was suppressed), objective_prefs_changed and layout_changed carry no user identity.
requirements.failure_behavior: When the clock is missing, stale, paused or not in progress, no alert fires and nothing is derived from wall or browser time. A backward or forward clock jump fires no backlog of passed alerts. When an announcer clip or critical warning is playing, the text alert still shows at its due time and the tone is not played (owner decision 2026-11-22, DEC-EVENT-RUNE-SPAWN revision 3); any game clip that starts during the tone preempts it, so the tone never stops, ducks or delays a clip or the critical cue. A timing without a sourced row in the table, or a respawn without a death signal, stays unavailable and is never shown as a time; rows not yet confirmed against official patch notes are marked so in the table. No memory reading, game input or hidden enemy information. Invalid lead times or a corrupt prefs file keep the last valid prefs (defaults if none) and are reported; they never change the honesty rules of the scheduler.

acceptance.given: a GSI clock stream in progress with all objectives enabled, including pauses, stale gaps, a backward jump, a forward jump and an announcer clip or critical warning playing at a due time; per-objective lead times set to valid and invalid values; a kill banner shown over the card; the app language set to Thai while the HUD window starts after the main window
acceptance.when: the clock passes 1:30, 1:45 and 2:00, then later spawn times, pauses and jumps
acceptance.then: the 2:00 water rune gets exactly one 30 s and one 15 s pre-warning and one spawn alert; bounty and wisdom runes get spawn alerts only; no alert fires while paused, stale or not in progress, and no backlog fires after a jump; Roshan and Tormentor respawn show unavailable; during a playing clip the text shows on time, the tone is not played, and the clip is not stopped, ducked or delayed; a game clip that starts during the tone preempts it; a disabled objective raises nothing; each enabled lead time gives exactly one pre-warning at that offset and invalid lead times (outside 5 to 60 s, duplicates, more than two) are rejected without changing the stored prefs; the card shows the English objective name with the app-language sentence (Thai when the saved app language is Thai, whenever the HUD window started), sits centred under the danger meter by default on a dark background under a light Windows theme, and may be covered by a video banner; its tone plays once the sink is idle within 5 s of the due time, otherwise it is suppressed and logged, and an announcer or critical clip is never cut, ducked or delayed; each objective's tone differs from the others; each shown alert writes one objective_alert_shown info line

requirements.implementation_freedom: Choose the scheduler home, tone synthesis and overlay transport inside existing crates; do not add crates or change Cargo.lock; do not alter the stated behavior or evidence thresholds.

requirements.title: Edge quick panel
requirements.statement: The optional edge orb shall reveal only after the pointer rests in its hot zone for the reveal dwell (default 1 s, adjustable), showing a continuous 80% to 100% scale cue during the dwell, and shall accept clicks only once revealed. Only the revealed circle and open panel may accept mouse clicks. The outermost 8 px shall remain click-through in every state. The orb shall never take keyboard focus, cover PROTECTED_REGIONS or appear outside a match, without Dota foreground, or in exclusive fullscreen. Its three-channel mixer and Focus mode are specified by UI-011. Each orb or panel click shall be checked for foreground activation; on activation the panel closes and the orb fails closed for the rest of the match. Keep honest status, a Settings off switch and a UI-006 keyboard-reachable twin for each control.
requirements.failure_behavior: A qualified critical alert closes the panel and locks the orb in the same admission without delaying the critical cue. Unknown status is never shown as ready. Log activation, close the panel and restore click-through immediately. Hide the orb if click-through cannot be guaranteed.

No orb or panel pixel intersects PROTECTED_REGIONS. The panel closes and the orb locks in the alert admission while the cue meets its acoustic deadline. Unknown stays unknown, the orb hides outside a match or in exclusive fullscreen, and an induced activation closes the panel, restores click-through and hides the orb until the match ends. requirements.title: Overlay layout editor
requirements.statement: Settings shall offer a layout edit mode that shows a 16:9 preview of the screen with each registered overlay widget as a box the user can drag and resize (scale presets or a slider). Boxes snap and clamp to the safe area: they never cover the protected regions (minimap, bottom HUD, top bar, announcement) nor the 8 px screen edges. The one exception (owner decision 2026-11-22, DEC-EVENT-RUNE-SPAWN revision 5) lets the map-objective card enter the top of the announcement region by at most 24 px at 1080, scaled with screen height, so that it can sit under the danger meter; every other widget stays fully blocked. A saved copy of an earlier default is read as the current default; any other saved layout still wins. Each widget has reset to default. Layouts persist per widget id in a local prefs file with a schema_version; the editor is reusable for other widgets, and only the map-objective card (ALERT-008) is registered now. The edit mode is a Settings surface; the in-game overlay stays click-through.
requirements.failure_behavior: An unreadable or invalid layout file or entry falls back to that widget's default and is reported; an out-of-bounds value is clamped into the safe area, never applied raw. Changing a layout never steals Dota focus or makes an overlay window interactive.

acceptance.given: the layout editor with the objective card at its default, 1920x1080 and 2560x1440 previews, and a corrupt layout file
acceptance.when: the user drags and resizes the card into protected regions and edges, resets it, and restarts
acceptance.then: the box always stays inside the safe area and off the protected regions except that the objective card may enter at most the top 24 px (at 1080, scaled with height) of the announcement region and is clamped there when dragged deeper, a widget without that allowance stays fully blocked, the default card sits centred under the danger meter with a 4 px gap, reset restores the default, the saved layout persists with its schema_version and is applied to the card in the overlay, a corrupt file falls back to the default, and each change writes one layout_changed info line

requirements.title: Per-application session volume
requirements.statement: Kohbor shall change only Windows Core Audio shared-mode session volume and mute on the default render device for the Dota 2 process and music processes selected by the user. It shall not inject input, access other processes' memory or files, or send session data over a network. Before the first change in a session, store each touched session's original level and mute locally; restore on application exit, orb/mixer disable, user Reset, and next start after abnormal exit. Re-read sessions after a default-device change or new session and never set a session that has not been read. Logs contain channel, executable base name and level only.
requirements.failure_behavior: Do not change an unreadable, missing or unselected process. On restore failure report it honestly and retain recovery data for the next start.

acceptance.when: the host sets, restores, crashes and restarts, and the default device or session changes
acceptance.then: only eligible Dota and selected music sessions change, originals restore on exit/disable/reset and after crash restart, changed devices/sessions are re-read before use, logs contain only the permitted fields, and no process input, memory or files are accessed; on the owner PC lower Dota and Chrome, kill Kohbor, restart and confirm original levels restore

requirements.title: Honest public statistics values and states
requirements.statement: Each displayed hero statistics value shall show its provider, provider-stated data window, fetch time and sample size. Label a missing data window as unspecified. Distinguish loading, live, stale, offline, rate-limited, provider error, unknown hero, not enough matches and consent off. Fix metric-specific minimum samples before evaluating data. Never show a match win-chance percentage. The v1 suggestions list shows historical bracket win rates and games; fewer than 1,000 games is a low-data state. Five position groups are estimates labelled “ค่าประมาณ” (estimate); listed heroes may already be picked or banned and this limitation is disclosed. No win-chance percentage is shown. Provider facts and unknowns are stated in the design: OpenDota heroStats and laneRoles have no stated data window, Immortal values were zero at review, lane data does not separate all five positions, and quota, licence and data window remain unverified.
requirements.failure_behavior: Withhold unsupported or undersampled values. Use eligible cached values only with explicit age and stale labelling when applicable. Never silently fall back, invent a number, reuse another hero's results or interpret missing data as zero.

acceptance.given: minimum samples have been fixed and fixtures cover valid and missing metadata, stale data, every unavailable state and sample sizes around the minima
acceptance.when: the host evaluates provider responses, cache expiry, a new hero and consent transitions
acceptance.then: each shown value carries source, window or unspecified label, fetch time and its sample size, every state is distinct, and insufficient or expired data produces no unsupported value. No invented value, silent fallback or win-chance percentage appears; the suggestions list shows source and sample, low-data below 1,000 games, labels estimated five-position groups, discloses possible banned/picked heroes, shows no win-chance percentage, and never fills unknown provider metadata

requirements.title: Warning quality
requirements.statement: High-danger audible false alerts shall be ≤1 per 30 minutes, actionable recall ≥90% and false-safe calls 0.
requirements.failure_behavior: Death alone is not ground truth and no coverage cannot be safe.

acceptance.given: independently labeled threat episodes are fixed before tuning
acceptance.when: each sensitivity profile is evaluated after dedup
acceptance.then: results meet each threshold with attribution/evidence

requirements.implementation_freedom: Choose internal implementation after freezing interfaces; do not alter the stated behavior, permissions or evidence thresholds.

requirements.title: Voice quality and speed
requirements.statement: Warm accepted voice turns shall begin audible answer within 2s each and complete ≥95% per language, with cold preparation ≤10s.
requirements.failure_behavior: Count failures/timeouts/rejects; synthetic scorer tests do not certify a model.

acceptance.given: at least 100 held-out utterances per language cover quiet/game-audio and separate speakers/sessions
acceptance.then: English WER ≤15%, Thai CER ≤20%, intent/critical-slot accuracy ≥90% and latency/completion pass

requirements.implementation_freedom: Choose internal implementation after freezing interfaces; do not alter the stated behavior, permissions or evidence thresholds.

requirements.title: Preemption under overlap
requirements.statement: All 100 overlap trials shall cancel stale voice/advice while retaining the critical acoustic deadline.
requirements.failure_behavior: Report failed/cancelled trials without pruning the denominator.

acceptance.given: each voice lifecycle stage overlaps critical admission
acceptance.then: every trial preempts obsolete output and meets the alert deadline

requirements.implementation_freedom: Choose internal implementation after freezing interfaces; do not alter the stated behavior, permissions or evidence thresholds.

requirements.title: Evidence-gated certification
requirements.statement: Every required OS/mode/geometry cell shall have at least 10 live sessions before certification.
requirements.failure_behavior: A unit test, browser screenshot or commit does not substitute for the missing evidence.

acceptance.given: a required cell lacks device or acoustic evidence
acceptance.then: the cell is SKIP/INDETERMINATE and the mandatory gate remains unsatisfied

requirements.implementation_freedom: Choose internal implementation after freezing interfaces; do not alter the stated behavior, permissions or evidence thresholds.
